surfaces_customer_facing.label: MEASURED
surfaces_customer_facing.definition: Customer-facing verticals satisfying the mandatory manifest condition. A non-zero count also requires live health and receipt conformance before publication.

platform_tests.label: UNAVAILABLE
platform_tests.definition: Passed and total tests from a fresh machine-readable test run.

ouroboros_tests.label: UNAVAILABLE
ouroboros_tests.definition: Passed and total tests from a fresh machine-readable test run.

mcp_e2e_tests.label: UNAVAILABLE
mcp_e2e_tests.definition: Passed and total tests from a fresh machine-readable test run.

monorepo_packages.label: MEASURED
monorepo_packages.definition: Workspace package manifests included by the canonical pnpm workspace, excluding explicit workspace exclusions.

api_endpoints.label: MEASURED
api_endpoints.definition: Express-style app/router/server HTTP verb call sites in route-bearing source files; this is a source count, not reachability.

db_tables.label: UNAVAILABLE
db_tables.definition: Tables present in the live canonical database after Drizzle introspection.

db_table_definitions_static.label: MEASURED
db_table_definitions_static.definition: Static pgTable/mysqlTable/sqliteTable call sites; this is not a live provisioned-table count.

ci_workflows.label: MEASURED
ci_workflows.definition: Workflow definition files in the platform repository.

github_public_repositories.label: MEASURED
github_public_repositories.definition: Current public repositories returned by GitHub; archived repositories remain included.

hf_models.label: MEASURED
hf_models.definition: Current public models attributed to the SZLHOLDINGS account.

hf_datasets.label: MEASURED
hf_datasets.definition: Current public datasets attributed to the SZLHOLDINGS account.

hf_spaces.label: MEASURED
hf_spaces.definition: Current public Spaces attributed to the SZLHOLDINGS account.

ghcr_a11oy_package_live.label: MEASURED
ghcr_a11oy_package_live.source: GHCR v2 tags probe for ghcr.io/szl-holdings/a11oy
ghcr_a11oy_package_live.definition: True only when the public registry grants pull scope and returns at least one tag; this is not a total package count.

lean_theorems_locked.label: REPORTED
lean_theorems_locked.definition: Theorems reported as locked and axiom-free; requires a fresh external Lean build for MEASURED status.

lean_sorry_count.label: UNAVAILABLE
lean_sorry_count.definition: Sorry declarations observed in a fresh Lean build.

doctrine_v11_declarations.label: REPORTED

doctrine_v11_unique_axioms.label: REPORTED
doctrine_v11_unique_axioms.definition: Unique axioms tracked across the locked Doctrine v11 corpus; not an axiom-free theorem count.

doctrine_v11_tracked_sorries.label: REPORTED
doctrine_v11_tracked_sorries.definition: Tracked sorry obligations across the locked Doctrine v11 corpus.

lambda_overhead_ms_median.label: UNAVAILABLE
lambda_overhead_ms_median.definition: Median measured Lambda overhead in milliseconds.

receipt_chain_depth.label: UNAVAILABLE
receipt_chain_depth.definition: Depth reported by the canonical live receipt-chain head endpoint.

latest.label: MEASURED
